en: Black‑and‑white / sepia military postcard showing German cavalry troops (Uhlans) conducting field exercises or combat in open countryside. Soldiers in spiked pickelhaube helmets and uniforms are aiming rifles while kneeling, lying prone, and advancing through tall grass. At the top, in red German text, is a caption that identifies the location Oschatz and the Saxon 1st Uhlan Regiment No. 17 and mentions the capture and reinforcement of a firing position.
